newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares start weaker on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: French shares start weaker on Wednesday.

text.p: French shares started weaker on Wednesday and extended their slight losses on news German that unemployment rose by 17,000 in July, giving a jobless rate of 11.4 percent. Expectations were for a 15,000 rise.
The higher than expected unemployment figure helped to dispell some expectations of a German short term interest rate rise, dealers said.
Wall Street has been lower overnight and the dollar set a new high against the mark. Money market dealers said the Bundesbank behaviour with the repo tender showed it did not want a rate rise.
* CAC-40 index down 7.49, or 0.25 percent, at 2,976.61 at 0803 GMT
* CAC-40 Aug futures 2,979 vs 2,989 at Tuesdays close.
"The market is very thin and jitterish due to concerns about the dollar/mark rate," said a dealer.
* L'Oreal said itS first half sales figure was up by 8.1 percent on a like-for-like basis to 34 billion francs. The share was down 0.25 percent at 2,379.
* Bouygues reported a 22 percent rise in sales to 41.7 billion francs which brokers Ferri said was better than expected. The share was down 0.20 percent at 505. First half profits due on Friday
* Elf up 0.45 percent at 676 francs in reaction to BP results.
* Saint-Gobain, down 0.22 percent at 887, reported first half sales up 32 percent.
